# Unit 3

Festivals and Holidays

put it in the oven. It looked like it would be delicious. My sister and I were excited.

But soon, we noticed something was wrong. The oven was not heating up. Dad checked it closely. Then he said in a low voice, It's broken!

Mum's heart nearly stopped. She didn't want her dinner to be a failure. We didn't know what to do. How were we going to teed everyone without the turkey? Mum looked worried.

Finally, Dad had an idea, and we all agreed with his suggestion to order pizza instead. After all, Thanksgiving is about giving thanks and spending time with your family. So we did not have turkey, it was different but there was nothing awful about it.
